Maria: Ok, snap quip-off. 1 word each. Ready? Go!
Aj: Velocity
Kelsey: Moonwalk
Oliver: Napkin
Maria: Bonus round: add an emoji next to your word
Aj: Velocity :rocket:
Kelsey: Moonwalk :dancer:
Oliver: Napkin :paperclip: (I was saving this one)
Kelsey: Also, quick ask — snack sign-up for Friday? who can bring cookies?
Maria: I can bring iced coffee if someone brings cookies :coffee:
Aj: Cookies — yes. I'll bring milk and a story.
Oliver: I volunteer napkins and bad jokes :grimacing:
Kelsey: I'll do gluten-free cookies :cookie:
DevBot: Reminder: All-hands in 10m — https://meet.link/handshake
Maria: Sweet. Quip-off winner: Aj for "Velocity :rocket:" (scientific judging)
Aj: Scientific, I appreciate the endorsement :mic_drop:
Kelsey: Prize is 1 cookie and bragging rights :trophy:
Oliver: Accepting both prizes
Maria: Meeting prep done, see y'all there :wave:
